description: Rig and animate a 2D game character from a picture on this computer, and save game-ready files next to it. It finds the joints, cuts a humanoid into parts, adds bones and animates idle, walk, run, attack, jump and more. With a GameShipKit Pro key (GAMESHIPKIT_KEY) it saves a Godot 4 skeleton scene, a Unity 2D Animation rig, a Spine 4.2 skeleton and sprite sheets of every move. Without a key it saves idle and walk sprite sheets. Uses the Edge or Chrome already installed. Give image_url instead of path to get a link that opens the rig on gameshipkit.com.

animations.description: With image_url: moves to play in the preview.

cut_parts.description: For humanoids: cut into head, body, arms and legs so limbs bend at the joints.

exports.description: With Pro: which files to save. Default: all four (godot, unity, spine, sheets).

image_url.description: Instead of path: a public link to the picture. Returns a link that opens the rig on gameshipkit.com, nothing is saved.

out_dir.description: Folder for the results. Default: a folder next to the picture.

path.description: Full path of the character picture on this computer (PNG, JPG or WebP). One full-body character, best on a plain or transparent background.

pixel_art.description: Keep sharp pixels for pixel art.

template.description: Skeleton: humanoid, quad (four legs), wing, snake (also fish, worms), simple (slimes, plants, items). Found automatically when left out.

name: rig_character
title: Rig a 2D character (local)
